recommendation.reason: 当前假设比较预测编码启发机制与标准反向传播基线，需要在相同数据和预算下真实训练并执行消融。

researchQuestion: 预测编码启发的局部迭代推理机制，在相同数据、模型容量与训练预算下，能否改善 FashionMNIST 分类或重构表现，并保持可接受的计算成本？
objective: 公平比较标准 backprop baseline、预测编码候选和关键组件消融，记录结果对下一轮实验计划的影响。
constraints: baseline、candidate 与 ablation 使用相同数据 split、seed 集和训练预算
synthetic smoke proxy 不得作为正式实验结果
负结果或统计不充分时结论必须为 refute 或 inconclusive

methodConfig.model: capacity-matched baseline classifier and predictive-coding-inspired candidate
methodConfig.baseline: standard backpropagation model under the same optimization budget
methodConfig.budget: same epochs, sample order policy, parameter-count tolerance and tuning budget
methodConfig.smokePlan: run one bounded batch and one evaluation batch to validate shapes, loss, logging and artifact persistence

successCriteria: candidate improves the primary metric under the declared fair budget or offers an explicitly justified accuracy-cost tradeoff
the improvement is not eliminated by the required seed and ablation checks
failureCriteria: candidate is consistently worse than baseline without an offsetting measured benefit
the proposed mechanism contribution disappears in the targeted ablation
inconclusiveCriteria: seed variance or budget mismatch prevents a fair conclusion
the run completes but the measured scope cannot distinguish the hypothesis from its alternatives

requiredArtifacts: model checkpoints or bounded result artifacts
artifactContract.retentionPolicy: retain all artifacts referenced by the competition case and its reproducibility package
